subject: Atlas Financial — SOC 2 / DPA walkthrough & calendar update

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Rajesh Patel <r.patel@atlas-fin.com>, procurement@atlas-fin.com
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Atlas Financial — SOC 2 / DPA walkthrough & calendar update

Hi Rajesh —

Thanks for the chat last week. We want to lock in a walkthrough to cover three things in one meeting: SOC 2 controls intake (high level), pen-test scheduling overlap and evidence handoff expectations, and a quick DPA review with your legal/procurement team. To keep it actionable, we usually run a 90-minute session but can compress to 60 if you confirm the pen-test vendor will cover live vuln validation.

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Tue Oct 6 — 10:00–11:30 PT
- Wed Oct 7 — 13:00–14:30 PT

We've attached the current SOC 2 questionnaire and our DPA draft so you can spot items beforehand (SOC2-questionnaire.xlsx, DPA_draft_v3.pdf).

Please send a preferred slot or feel free to suggest alternatives. If helpful, I can loop in Laura (security lead) and Ben (customer success) to make sure we cover attestation mappings and onboarding steps.

Agenda (short):
1) Introductions & scope (10m)
2) SOC 2 control map & evidence flow (30–40m)
3) DPA highlights & open clauses (20m)
4) Pen-test coordination & timeline (20m)
5) Next steps / action items (10m)

Thanks —
Michael Grant
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
attachments: SOC2-questionnaire.xlsx (spreadsheet), DPA_draft_v3.pdf (pdf)
